themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: The Wall Street Journal reported Sunday that the administration plans to name more than two dozen AI companies, Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon and Anthropic among them, as US 'national champions', with faster export licenses and federal financing; Commerce could announce it this week (Seeking Alpha via TradingView). The Fed's November stability report counted over $1.1 trillion of public debt tied to AI computing, plus more than $3 trillion of unstarted leases and take or pay or resale guarantees off balance sheets (Traders and Quants; Markets Digest). Monday premarket, TSMC closed down nearly 6% in Taipei and NVDA, AMD and ENTG traded 4% to 6% lower; Mizuho cut its NVDA target to $220 and TD Cowen to $200 (TradingView; Dow Jones).
themes.for_you: No action before Nvidia reports Tuesday after the close. Premarket moves are not closes: AMD (500.52 premarket) and ENTG (140.00) sit under their long term points from the Nov 13 build, so wait for a close back over 525.17 and 147.51 before any first tranche. No puts on either this week.
